text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 467 Soudan Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is to address concerns that the tree poses a safety hazard. The subject tree is an Austrian pine (Pinus nigra), measuring 46 cm in diameter. The Private Tree By-law does not support the removal of the tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on October 1 and 4, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 467 Soudan Avenue.
